name: Okta Workforce Identity
summary: Okta Workforce Identity bundles single sign-on and MFA from $6 per user per month, billed annually with a $1,500 annual minimum. Adaptive MFA is a paid add-on on the Starter suite and is included from Core Essentials upward.

evidence.capability: second-factor methods such as app push or hardware keys

facts.text: Okta's supported factor list includes Okta Verify, WebAuthn, YubiKey, Duo Security, SMS, voice call and email.
Okta describes contextual access policies that assess devices, networks, locations, user behavior and IP addresses.
Authenticator enrollment policies apply to user groups and mark each authenticator as optional, required or disabled, with grace periods available for required authenticators.
MFA for RDP does not support Duo Security or FIDO2 (WebAuthn) factors.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Includes SSO and MFA. Adaptive MFA is an add-on with no published price

plans.name: Core Essentials
plans.notes: Adaptive MFA shown as included in the comparison table

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Adds Adaptive MFA, Privileged Access and Lifecycle Management

hiddenCosts: Workforce Identity has a $1,500 annual contract minimum.
Adaptive MFA is an add-on on Starter, and the page lists no price for it.
